title: Database user created with a literal password in sql — review required
description: CREATE USER or ALTER USER with an inline password literal stores a credential in the migration or bootstrap script. The value enters version control, backups and shell history, and it cannot be rotated without editing the script. The rule flags the literal; whether the account is a real login is a review decision.
remediation: Create the account without a password, deliver the secret through an approved secret store, and rotate it out of band.
limitation: Lexical: matches a quoted password literal; a password supplied through a variable is out of scope.

tests.line: # audit: CREATE USER app_user IDENTIFIED BY 'changeme'; present
# verified: CREATE USER app_user IDENTIFIED BY :secret;
